body.statement: For every \(m\in\mathcal M_n(B)\), \(\overline Y_l^{\mathrm{obs}}(D)\) is measurable with respect to \(D\), and \(A_l=1\) implies \(\overline Y_l^{\mathrm{obs}}(D)=\mu_l(a)\), while \(C_l=1\) implies \(\overline Y_l^{\mathrm{obs}}(D)=\mu_l(b)\).
body.justification: This measurability bridge licenses every occurrence of the fixed-schedule block target mean in the expectation calculation without placing it inside the reported statistic.
body.gap: Exposure-weighted estimators are standard, but the clique reduction requires an explicit observed-data equality on each mutually exclusive unanimous event.
body.consumer: The block estimator, clipped interval, and software diagnostic consume only assignment and observed outcomes.
